expectations.text: Recommends a design-family skill whose scope matches redesigning an existing UI to avoid generic/AI-looking output (e.g. a redesign- or anti-generic-focused skill), not an image-generation or brand-kit skill
expectations.evidence: Primary taste-skill:redesign-skill + co-primary design-master; imagegen/brandkit skipped as 'overkill for restyling a working product'.

expectations.text: Lists at least one considered-and-rejected skill with a specific, task-grounded reason (not just 'less relevant')
expectations.evidence: 'Skills to skip' section with reasons, e.g. frontend-design/taste-skill 'redundant with design-master + redesign-skill, which are more specific to your case'.

expectations.text: Assessment only: does not begin the redesign or write any UI code
expectations.evidence: Plan is prefixed 'when you're ready to start'; no code written.

expectations.text: Output contains an explicit verdict line stating what runs and in what order
expectations.evidence: No single verdict; 'Bottom line' offers two alternative combos ('minimum viable' vs 'best-fit full combo' of 3-5 skills) and defers the actual pick to the user. Execution order lives in a separate plan section, and primary vs co-primary is left unresolved.
